title: Tavi

paragraphs: In [Bava Batra 48b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.48b.7), he was a violent man who wanted to hang Pappi and forced him to sell him his field. Rabbah bar Bar Chana signed a declaration of protest [against the coerced sale].[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson vocalized text of Bava Batra 48b names Tavi suspending Pappi and compelling the sale, and Rabbah bar bar Chana signing the protest. Hyman’s notice says that Tavi wanted to hang Pappi; that wording is retained.

The linked Gemara says Tavi suspended Pappi, while Hyman says Tavi wanted to hang him. The Gemara also says Rabbah bar Bar Chana signed the sale document in addition to the prior declaration. Hyman mentions only the declaration.
